subject: ENG
body: Choose the option nearest in meaning to the word in capitals: The manager's decision was ARBITRARY.
explanation: Arbitrary means decided by personal choice or whim rather than by reason or rules.

subject: ENG
body: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the word in capitals: The witness gave a CANDID account of the incident.
explanation: Candid means frank and open; its opposite is evasive (avoiding the truth).

subject: ENG
body: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ in the hall.
explanation: With 'neither…nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Students' is plural, so 'were'.

subject: ENG
body: Emeka is the ___ of the two brothers.
explanation: Use the comparative form ('taller') when comparing two people; the superlative is for three or more.

subject: ENG
body: Choose the correctly spelt word.
explanation: Accommodation has double 'c' and double 'm'.

subject: ENG
body: After years of quarrelling, the two families finally decided to BURY THE HATCHET. This means they decided to
explanation: To bury the hatchet means to end a quarrel and make peace.

subject: ENG
body: You are coming to the party, ___?
explanation: A positive statement takes a negative tag with the same auxiliary and subject: 'You are… aren't you?'

subject: ENG
body: She has been living in Abuja ___ 2019.
explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time (2019); 'for' is used with a period (e.g. for six years).

explanation: Add indices when multiplying and subtract when dividing: 2^(3+4−5) = 2² = 4.

subject: MTH
body: If sin θ = 3/5 and θ is acute, find cos θ.
explanation: Use a 3-4-5 right triangle: opposite 3, hypotenuse 5, so adjacent = 4. cos θ = 4/5.

subject: MTH
body: A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of getting at least one head?
explanation: P(no heads) = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4, so P(at least one head) = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4.

subject: PHY
body: What is the SI unit of force?
explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N). 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².

subject: PHY

subject: PHY
body: Calculate the kinetic energy of a 2 kg body moving at 3 m/s.
explanation: KE = ½mv² = ½ × 2 × 3² = 9 J.

subject: PHY
body: Which of these is a vector quantity?
explanation: Velocity has both magnitude and direction. Speed, mass and energy have magnitude only.

subject: PHY

subject: PHY
body: A machine does 600 J of work in 2 minutes. What is its power?
explanation: Power = work ÷ time = 600 J ÷ 120 s = 5 W. Remember to convert minutes to seconds.

subject: PHY
body: Which of these does NOT affect the pressure at a point in a liquid?
explanation: P = hρg. Pressure depends on depth, density and g — not on the shape of the container.

subject: CHM
body: The atomic number of an element is the number of
explanation: Atomic number = number of protons. Protons + neutrons = mass number.

subject: CHM
body: What is the pH of a neutral solution at 25 °C?
explanation: At 25 °C, neutral solutions have pH 7. Below 7 is acidic, above 7 is alkaline.

subject: CHM
body: A compound contains 40% carbon, 6.7% hydrogen and 53.3% oxygen by mass. Find its empirical formula. (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16)

subject: CHM
body: How many moles are in 22 g of carbon(IV) oxide? (C = 12, O = 16)
explanation: Molar mass of CO₂ = 12 + 32 = 44 g/mol. Moles = 22 ÷ 44 = 0.5.

subject: CHM
body: Which of these is a noble gas?
explanation: Argon is in Group 0 (18) with helium, neon, krypton, xenon and radon.

subject: CHM
body: What is the oxidation number of manganese in KMnO₄?
explanation: K = +1, each O = −2 (total −8). +1 + Mn − 8 = 0, so Mn = +7.

subject: CHM
body: Which gas turns lime water milky?
explanation: CO₂ reacts with lime water (calcium hydroxide) to form insoluble calcium carbonate, which looks milky.

subject: CHM
body: The bond in sodium chloride is
explanation: Sodium transfers an electron to chlorine, forming Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions held by electrovalent (ionic) bonds.

subject: BIO
body: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
explanation: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration, releasing energy as ATP.

subject: BIO
body: In green plants, photosynthesis takes place in the
explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which traps light energy for photosynthesis.

subject: BIO
body: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart?
explanation: The pulmonary vein is the only vein that carries oxygenated blood — from the lungs to the left atrium.

subject: BIO
body: In a cross between two heterozygous tall plants (Tt × Tt), where T (tall) is dominant, what proportion of the offspring will be tall?
explanation: Offspring: TT, Tt, Tt, tt. Three of four have at least one T, so 3/4 are tall.

subject: BIO

explanation: Only the female Anopheles mosquito feeds on blood and transmits Plasmodium, the malaria parasite.

subject: BIO
body: The enzyme present in human saliva is
explanation: Salivary amylase (ptyalin) starts the digestion of starch in the mouth.

subject: BIO
body: In the food chain grass → grasshopper → lizard → hawk, the producer is the
explanation: Producers make their own food by photosynthesis. Grass is the only producer in this chain.

subject: BIO
body: The functional unit of the kidney is the
explanation: Each kidney has about a million nephrons, which filter blood and form urine.

subject: ECO

explanation: Opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative given up when a choice is made.

subject: ECO

explanation: The law of demand: the higher the price, the lower the quantity demanded, ceteris paribus.

subject: ECO
body: If a 10% rise in price causes a 20% fall in quantity demanded, the price elasticity of demand is
explanation: PED = % change in quantity ÷ % change in price = 20 ÷ 10 = 2 (elastic).

subject: ECO
body: Which of these is a direct tax?
explanation: Direct taxes are paid straight to government by the person taxed, such as income tax. VAT and duties are indirect.

subject: ECO
body: Which of these is a function of the Central Bank of Nigeria?
explanation: The CBN issues the naira, acts as banker to government and other banks, and controls money supply.

subject: ECO
body: Inflation is a
options: persistent rise in the general price level
fall in the value of exports
rise in the price of one commodity
explanation: Inflation is a sustained rise in the general level of prices, which reduces the purchasing power of money.

subject: ECO
body: The reward for land as a factor of production is
explanation: Land earns rent, labour earns wages, capital earns interest and entrepreneurship earns profit.

subject: ECO
body: A market with only one seller of a product with no close substitutes is a
explanation: A monopoly has a single seller. An oligopoly has a few, a duopoly has two.

explanation: Nigeria gained independence in 1960 and became a republic on 1 October 1963.

subject: GOV

explanation: Nigeria became independent on 1 October 1960.

subject: GOV
body: The theory of separation of powers is associated with
explanation: Baron de Montesquieu set out the theory in 'The Spirit of the Laws' (1748).

subject: GOV
body: The arm of government that interprets the law is the
explanation: The legislature makes laws, the executive carries them out, and the judiciary interprets them.

subject: GOV
body: How many states are there in Nigeria?
explanation: Nigeria has 36 states plus the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja. 774 is the number of local government areas.

subject: GOV
body: The federal legislature in Nigeria is called the
explanation: The National Assembly has two chambers: the Senate and the House of Representatives.

subject: GOV

explanation: Franchise (suffrage) is the right to vote in elections.

subject: GOV

explanation: A rigid constitution needs a special, harder procedure to amend. Nigeria's constitution is rigid.
